info.title: KhordQuiz API
info.description: API for the KhordQuiz mobile app. Sign in to receive a Sanctum token, then send it as a Bearer token. Catalog, plans, and help are public.

post.description: Creates a member, records that the terms were accepted, and returns a token for profile setup.
Revokes the token used for this request. Other devices stay signed in.

patch.description: Used after registration to save the avatar and skill level. Send only the fields that should change.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit code when the email belongs to an account. The response is the same either way. The code expires after 15 minutes.
Five wrong attempts cancel the code.
Uses the reset token from verify-otp and signs every device out.

422.description: Invalid reset session or validation failed

200.description: Categories, quizzes, sounds, and question counts
Greeting, streak, goal, up next, and achievements
Accuracy, categories, week, mistakes, and recent quizzes
Answers and completions removed. Bookmarks stay.
Access, plan, trial, and billing history
Local plan record. The store still confirms payment.
Messages, starting with the welcome note

201.description: Your message, plus the first automatic reply

country.description: A country name from the KhordQuiz country list.

code.description: Six-digit code from the reset email.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum token from register or login. Paste the token only; Swagger adds the Bearer prefix.
